metadata.title: Cloud Networking

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enforcing segmentation, controlled connectivity, and exposure management in cloud environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud virtual networks, routing, security groups, private connectivity, and provider-managed networking fabrics.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes trust boundaries, segmentation, and controlled connectivity within and across cloud networks.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud networking builds on baseline cloud infrastructure trust assumptions.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Networking defines the trust properties required to enforce segmentation, limit exposure, and control connectivity in cloud environments. Because cloud networks are software-defined and provider-managed, explicit governance is required to prevent unintended access and lateral movement.

components.title: Cloud Network Segmentation
components.description: Separation of cloud workloads into distinct network zones with explicitly controlled connectivity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement across improperly segmented cloud network zones.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logical segmentation of cloud networks to restrict east-west movement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection enforced through cloud network segmentation.
Information flow control between segmented cloud network zones.

components.title: Cloud Exposure Management
components.description: Explicit management of which cloud resources are externally reachable.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Network service discovery enabled by unintended cloud exposure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Filtering and restriction of inbound and outbound cloud network traffic.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Limit exposed services and network functionality.
Control and limit external network connections.

components.title: Cloud Private Connectivity
components.description: Use of private, non-public connectivity between cloud resources and trusted networks.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Discovery of services exposed through public cloud networking.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Private connectivity mechanisms reducing reliance on public network paths.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Use of private network paths for sensitive connectivity.
Device and network access restrictions for private cloud connectivity.
